verdict.rationale: The official Node client exposes a `validate` method for VAT numbers, so some B2B tax-ID validation exists. Nothing shows how it works or how cross-border B2B sales are taxed, and TaxJar positions itself as built for businesses that only sell in the US. Missing for 10: evidence that validation runs in real time against official registries (e.g., VIES), any documented reverse-charge handling for B2B cross-border transactions, validation of non-EU tax IDs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
